last.verdict: DraftKings slashed 2026 profit guidance to $175-275 million from $700-900 million to fund prediction markets, betting 2027 pays off.

takeaways.label: Profit outlook gutted
takeaways.text: 2026 adjusted EBITDA (operating profit before some costs) guidance fell to $175-275 million from $700-900 million. Predictions spending of $650-700 million is the main cause. Revenue guidance fell to $6.35-6.55 billion.

takeaways.label: Core business also softer
takeaways.text: Excluding Predictions, 2026 adjusted EBITDA is now guided at $875-925 million, below the roughly $1 billion expected in August. Management cited extra iGaming investment and customer-friendly sports results.

takeaways.label: Rebound promised for 2027
takeaways.text: 2027 guidance is revenue of $7.35-7.75 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $800 million-$1 billion. That includes $650-750 million of Predictions revenue and about $300 million of Predictions spending.

takeaways.label: Growth bought with losses
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 16% to $1.33 billion and monthly paying users rose 13% to 4.1 million. Net loss reached $469 million, versus $257 million a year earlier.

history.verdict: Investors looked past a revenue miss to strong user growth and unchanged full-year profit targets.

reasons.label: Surging customer growth
reasons.text: Monthly paying users rose 9% to 3.6 million, about 16% above expectations.

reasons.label: Guidance held
reasons.text: Full-year profit outlook stayed at $700-900 million; core business should earn about $1 billion.

reasons.label: Prediction markets momentum
reasons.text: New Predictions product has over 600,000 users and is growing faster than management expected.
